Class.name: ITFCOMMON.Utility
Class.Description:
Contains Common set of methods for Interface team.
Developed Jan 2014 by Intermountain Interface Team.

ITFCOMMON.Utility

has following methods:

  • ItfCommonLookup
  • ItfLookup
  • GetMaxError
  • SkipMsgError

Also contains following methods to call Web Service:

  1. GetHddNcidForRep
  2. GetHddRepForNcid
  3. CallMyDivideWebMethod

A utility function to save string to a file.

Syntax for calling Utility functions:
Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).METHODNAME()

Method.name: ItfCommonLookup
Method.Implementation:
set stat = $$$OK set retVal = "" NEW $NAMESPACE SET $NAMESPACE = "ITFCOMMON" set retVal = ##class(Ens.Util.FunctionSet).Lookup(tableNm, key) if (retVal = "") { set retVal = defVal set stat = $$$ERROR($$$GeneralError, "Value not found") }
Quit stat
